recipes.name: One-Pot Mac & Cheeze
ingredients: ½ cup plain vegan cream cheese
instructions: Add the water, milk, pasta, apple cider vinegar, and bouillon to a saucepan. Cook uncovered at a gentle simmer until al dente, about 10 mintues. Stir throughout to prevent sticking.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir until thick and glossy. The sauce will also continue to thicken as it cools.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † For best results, stick with the traditional macaroni shape since the cooking time and liquid ratio is best.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
